article_manifest.title: Securing the territory: significant terrorist positions neutralised near Kadiane and Boulkessi
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurisation du territoire : importantes positions terroristes neutralisées près de Kadiana et Boulkessi
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the use of precise intelligence made it possible to locate a major base of armed terrorist groups, spread across two positions located five (05) and eight (08) kilometres respectively north-east of Kadiana.

article_manifest.title: Two children from Mali
article_manifest.original_title: Deux enfants du Mali
article_manifest.summary: Column By Hassan Adrar Eleven years ago, on 13 November 2015, Paris was bleeding. One hundred and thirty people were killed at the Bataclan, on the terraces, near the Stade de France, and in Saint-Denis. This year, the anniversary has a special feel to it.

article_manifest.title: Boulkessi and Kadiana: The FAMa strike terrorist bases and assembly points In a statement published on 13 November 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces provided an update on the recent operations carried out by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners. article_manifest.original_title: Boulkessi et Kadiana : les FAMa frappent des bases et points de regroupement terroristes Dans un communiqué publié ce 13 novembre 2026, l’état-major général des Armées a fait le point sur les récentes opérations menées par les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa), appuyées par leurs partenaires. Ces actions qui s’inscrivent dans
article_manifest.summary: The document states that, on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the use of precise intelligence made it possible to locate a major base of armed terrorist groups, spread over two positions located five and eight kilometres respectively north-east of Kadiana. It housed several individuals as well as military equipment, including motorcycles and vehicles. .

article_manifest.title: Kadiana and Boulkessi: The army announces strikes against terrorist bases
article_manifest.original_title: Kadiana et Boulkessi : l’armée annonce des frappes contre des bases terroristes
article_manifest.summary: According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out several airstrikes on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, with the support of their partners. These actions are part of Operation Dougoukoloko, which aims to monitor and secure the national territory. .

article_manifest.title: Ménaka: Food aid reaches displaced people in Tagadayat
article_manifest.original_title: Ménaka : l’aide alimentaire arrive chez les déplacés de Tagadayat
article_manifest.summary: The ICRC and the Malian Red Cross are assisting a thousand households living in the town. These families left their locality after the attack on 18 October. Rice, millet, lentils, beans, oil and salt have been distributed to displaced families from Tagadayat since 11 November.

article_manifest.title: Mali: What are the four activists who have gone from State Security to prison accused of?
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Que reproche-t-on aux 4 militants passés de la Sécurité d'État à la prison?
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, RFI is able to provide details about the proceedings initiated against four pro-democracy activists who were released by State Security at the end of October. Abducted in May 2026 and held for nearly six months in the secret prisons of the Malian services, in complete illegality, Youssouf Daba Diawara, Aboubacar Soumaré, Moussa "Abba" Djiré and Ibrahima Tamega "reappeared" on 20 October to be officially remanded in custody by the anti-cybercrime judicial unit.

article_manifest.title: Niger: "In response to the arrival of...
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: "En réagissant à l'arrivée de...
article_manifest.summary: For Ibrahim Namaiwa, the presence of Algerian soldiers in Niger stems directly from the cooperation agreements between the two countries. He believes that securing major joint projects, particularly the Trans-Saharan Highway and oil exploitation, justifies this military cooperation. .

article_manifest.title: Bamako: urban anarchy, this tangled mess...
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : l’anarchie urbaine, ce nœud...
article_manifest.summary: Bamako: Urban anarchy, that Gordian knot that governors have never managed to cut through. Abdoulaye Coulibaly faces the challenge of doing better than Abdoulaye Sacko and Ami Kane. In Bamako, clearing public thoroughfares has become an exercise that is as frequent as it is unsuccessful.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Ten people deported from Guinea found dead
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : dix morts parmi les personnes refoulées de Guinée
article_manifest.summary: The death toll in Mali among people deported from gold mining areas in Guinea has risen to ten, following confirmation of a new death on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, according to the Centre for Crisis Coordination and Management (CECOGEC). In its press release No. 2026-10, CECOGEC states that no new arrivals of affected people were recorded on Wednesday in the district of Bamako.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso’s rival armed groups turn on each other as state loses ground
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso’s rival armed groups turn on each other as state loses ground
article_manifest.summary: Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso – Armed fighters from two rival groups have fought a series of increasingly deadly battles along Burkina Faso’s northern border with Mali, as the government struggles to reassert control over large parts of the country. The clashes between Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM), an al-Qaeda affiliate, and the ISIL affiliate in Sahel Province (ISSP) have intensified since early September, with both groups competing for territory and influence across the borderlands.

article_manifest.title: Mali: What are the four activists who have been transferred from State Security to prison accused of?
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: que reproche-t-on aux 4 militants passés de la Sécurité d'État à la prison?
article_manifest.summary: Mali: What are the 4 activists who went from State Security to prison accused of? In Mali, RFI is able to provide details on the proceedings brought against four pro-democracy activists released by State Security at the end of October. .

article_manifest.title: First World War: The Italian Embassy in Niger celebrates National Unity and Armed Forces Day
article_manifest.original_title: Première Guerre Mondiale : L’ambassade d’Italie au Niger célèbre la journée de l’Unité nationale et des forces armées
article_manifest.summary: On Monday, 9 November 2026, the Italian diplomatic representation in Niger celebrated the traditional National Unity and Armed Forces Day, which commemorates the end of the First World War in Italy. The event was attended by several civilian and military dignitaries, as well as members of the diplomatic corps accredited to Niger. According to the Italian diplomat, Armed Forces Day is celebrated in Italy every 4 November.

article_manifest.title: Ségou: A young man found dead on a construction site in Markala
article_manifest.original_title: Ségou : un jeune homme retrouvé mort sur un chantier à Markala
article_manifest.summary: The body of a young man was found this Thursday on his older brother's construction site in Markala, 35 kilometres from Ségou. The tragedy occurred during the night of Tuesday, 10 November to Wednesday, 11 November 2026. According to local sources, the victim was on night watch at the site.

article_manifest.title: Atiku: Nigerians deserve clear account of what is being done to stop killings
article_manifest.original_title: Atiku: Nigerians deserve clear account of what is being done to stop killings
article_manifest.summary: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar, presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), has accused President Bola Tinubu of failing to protect Nigerians, saying the deaths of 638 people in insecurity incidents in one month and the flight of nearly 64,000 Nigerians to Niger expose a security crisis the government has failed to contain. A report by the Foundation for Investigative Journalism, citing the Centre for Democracy and Development’s October tracker, says 638 people were killed in broader insecurity incidents during the month.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Kayes: Arrival of a large convoy of several tanker trucks
article_manifest.original_title: Kayes: Arrivée d’un important convoi de plusieurs camions citernes
article_manifest.summary: Kayes, 12 November (AMAP) As announced in our previous article on the weekly meeting of the Crisis and Disaster Management Committee regarding the hydrocarbon situation in our region, a convoy of several tanker trucks arrived in the Cité des Rails this afternoon, AMAP observed. According to the Regional Director of Trade, Robo Bayo, this large convoy of fuel entered Kayes under the escort of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), "whom we commend for their commitment and courage".

article_manifest.title: ARMED FORCES GENERAL STAFF: A series of meetings with foreign delegations on the sidelines of BAMEX
article_manifest.original_title: ÉTAT-MAJOR GENERAL DES ARMÉES : une série d’audiences avec des délégations étrangères en marge du BAMEX
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Élisée Jean DAO, received several foreign delegations participating in BAMEX in audience on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. These meetings included the Director General of Sudan's Defence Industry, representatives of the company LZ TECH, and the heads of the Algerian and Pakistani delegations.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Kayes: Rates of decrease in hydrocarbon stocks that could be increased
article_manifest.original_title: Kayes : Des taux de diminution de stocks d’hydrocarbures qui pourront être relevés
article_manifest.summary: Kayes, 12 November (AMAP) – During its weekly meeting held on Thursday at the governorate, the Crisis and Disaster Management Committee, addressing the situation regarding hydrocarbons in the Kayes Region, noted a decrease in stocks due to the non-arrival of any convoys, as reported by AMAP. The Governor's Adviser for Security and Civil Protection, Colonel Adama Bamba, chaired the meeting, accompanied by the Regional Director of Trade, Robo Bayo.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The army announces two successful operations near Koumantou and Tonka
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : l’armée annonce deux opérations réussies près de Koumantou et Tonka
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces has announced two actions carried out on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), with the support of their partners. They are part of Operation Dougoukoloko, which aims to monitor and secure the national territory. .

article_manifest.title: BAMEX 2026: Niger unveils two locally designed military vehicles in Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: BAMEX 2026 : le Niger dévoile à Bamako deux véhicules militaires conçus localement
article_manifest.summary: The second edition of the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition, which ends this Friday, 13 November, served as a platform for a significant announcement. The Nigerien Armed Forces unveiled two military vehicles that were entirely designed and manufactured in Niger. As a reminder, the first edition of BAMEX, held in November 2025 in the Malian capital, had already highlighted the theme of an independent security architecture.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The Chadian Minister of the Armed Forces received by the Transitional President, Assimi Goïta
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : le ministre tchadien des Armées reçu par le président de la Transition Assimi Goïta
article_manifest.summary: On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, in Koulouba, the President of Mali's Transitional Government, Army General Assimi Goïta, received a Chadian delegation led by the Minister of the Armed Forces, War Veterans and War Victims, Lieutenant General Issakha Malloua. Discussions focused in particular on strengthening cooperation between Chad and Mali in the fields of defence and security.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: FAMa: Five terrorists neutralised and equipment recovered in two operations in Koumantou and Tonkan
article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : Cinq terroristes neutralisés et des équipements récupérés dans deux opérations à Koumantou et à Tonkan
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 12 November (AMAP) The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, neutralised five terrorists during two operations carried out on Wednesday, respectively at the Bablena crossroads, west of Koumantou, and south of Tonka, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces published on Thursday.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa intercept armed groups in Bablena and neutralise terrorist drone operators near Tonka
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa interceptent des groupes armés à Bablena et neutralisent des opérateurs de drones terroristes près de Tonka
article_manifest.summary: Thanks to the use of precise intelligence, the Malian Armed Forces carried out two targeted operations in the Koumantou and Tonka sectors on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. The provisional report issued by the General Staff of the Armed Forces states that five terrorists were neutralised, four motorcycles and three submachine guns were recovered, and a drone was destroyed.

article_manifest.title: Ségou: A young man found dead on a construction site in Markala
article_manifest.original_title: Ségou : un jeune homme retrouvé mort sur un chantier à Markala
article_manifest.summary: Le corps d’un jeune homme a été retrouvé ce jeudi sur le chantier de son grand frère à Markala, à 35 kilomètres de Ségou. Le drame s’est produit dans la nuit du mardi 10 au mercredi 11 novembre 2026. Selon des sources locales, la victime assurait la garde nocturne du chantier.

article_manifest.title: Journalist Serge Mathurin Adou released after two years in prison in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Le journaliste Serge Mathurin Adou libéré après deux ans de prison au Niger
article_manifest.summary: - RFI, 12 November 2026 In Niger, journalist Serge Mathurin Adou was released on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, after two years in prison. He had been… More » In Niger, journalist Serge Mathurin Adou was released on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, after two years in prison. He had been convicted of undermining state security following accusations of conspiracy from neighbouring Burkina Faso.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Macina: National Day of Traditional Authorities celebrated
article_manifest.original_title: Macina : la journée nationale des légitimités traditionnelles célébrée
article_manifest.summary: Macina, 12 November (AMAP) As part of the celebrations for the 5th edition of National Day of Traditional Authorities, Prefect Albaraka Ag Amarizag led a discussion in the Cercle's conference room on the roles and responsibilities of traditional authorities, with the theme "Danbé and Maya", AMAP reported. . He was accompanied by Deputy Mayor Mamadou Almamy Tangara, the Sub-Prefect of Kolongotomo, Bourama N.

article_manifest.title: Ouagadougou: Around 350 kg of cannabis seized by the police in Saaba
article_manifest.original_title: Ouagadougou : environ 350 kg de cannabis saisis par la police à Saaba
article_manifest.summary: The National Police seized approximately 350 kg of cannabis during a checkpoint operation on national road No. 4, on the Ouagadougou–Fada N'Gourma route, near the bypass road. The drugs were being transported in a tricycle that was intercepted by officers from the Saaba District Police Station and the Republican Security Company (CRS), as part of Operation WIBGA 3.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Bamako: A fire causes extensive damage at the Grand Marché, with no loss of life
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : un incendie fait d’énormes dégâts sans perte en vie humaine au Grand marché
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 12 November (AMAP) A fire that broke out on Wednesday at around 4 a.m. caused enormous damage at Bamako's Grand Market, but there were no fatalities, AMAP reported. On Rue du 18 Juin, the fire gutted shops, reduced bales of fabric to ashes, destroyed dozens of businesses and huge bundles of francs.

article_manifest.title: Between Us: Assimi must take responsibility!
article_manifest.original_title: Entre Nous: Assimi doit s’assumer !
article_manifest.summary: The arrival in Malian territory of tens of thousands of gold panners expelled by the Guinean government has brought the thorny issue of illegal mining to the forefront of national news. An issue that requires a concrete response beyond the management of this human tide .

article_manifest.title: Defence diplomacy: Three foreign delegations received at Koulouba on the sidelines of BAMEX 2026
article_manifest.original_title: Diplomatie de défense : Trois délégations étrangères reçues à Koulouba en marge du BAMEX 2026
article_manifest.summary: BILATERAL COOPERATION: The Transitional President receives three foreign delegations at Koulouba As part of the 2nd edition of the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX) 2026, the Transitional President, His Excellency General of the Army Assimi Goïta, Head of State, granted a series of audiences on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, to three foreign delegations.

article_manifest.title: Illegal gold mining: The problem runs deeper
article_manifest.original_title: Orpaillage clandestin : Le mal est plus profond
article_manifest.summary: Obviously, this is not about defending the unregulated exploitation of gold. Its consequences are well known: devastated agricultural land, polluted waterways, weakened ecosystems and populations exposed to toxic substances. In the long run, an entire natural heritage risks being sacrificed on the altar of immediate wealth.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Journalist Serge Mathurin Adou released after two years in prison
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: Le journaliste Serge Mathurin Adou libéré après deux ans de prison
article_manifest.summary: In Niger, journalist Serge Mathurin Adou was released on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, after two years in prison. He had been convicted of undermining state security following accusations of conspiracy from neighbouring Burkina Faso. .

article_manifest.title: More than 66,000 Nigerians have fled to Benin and Niger, and the UNHCR is issuing an appeal
article_manifest.original_title: Plus de 66 000 Nigérians réfugiés au Bénin et au Niger, le HCR lance un appel
article_manifest.summary: The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) is concerned about the humanitarian situation in northern Nigeria, where violence is forcing residents to flee, according to a report published on 5 November 2026. Since January 2026, more than 66,000 Nigerians have crossed the border into Niger and Benin, three times more than in the same period in 2025.

article_manifest.title: Mali: The army seizes 2,000 radios intended for armed groups near Timbuktu
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : l’armée saisit 2 000 radios destinées à des groupes armés près de Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) announced that they had intercepted a large consignment of communications equipment consisting of 2,000 portable radios, a pick-up truck and eight motorcycles, north of Timbuktu, as part of an operation to dismantle suspected supply chains for armed terrorist groups. . According to an army report, the interception took place on Monday, 9 November, during Operation Dougoukoloko, conducted under the supervision of Colonel Cheick Abdoul Kader Diarra, Chief of Operations at the Sector 3 Coordination Centre.

article_manifest.title: Grand Patriotic Night in Tougan: Sourou mobilises to honour its Defence and Security Forces and VDPs
article_manifest.original_title: Grande Nuit Patriotique à Tougan : Le Sourou se mobilise pour honorer ses FDS et VDP
article_manifest.summary: With just a few hours to go until the 'Great Patriotic Night', scheduled for Saturday 14 November 2026 at the Tougan multi-purpose hall, excitement is sweeping through the entire Sourou province. Dedicated to paying tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Homeland (VDP), this event aims to strengthen the bond between the armed forces and the nation around the ideals of sovereignty and the Popular Progressive Revolution (RPP).

article_manifest.title: Bobo-Dioulasso: Two prison officers arrested in connection with a case of forgery of nationality certificates
article_manifest.original_title: Bobo-Dioulasso : Deux agents pénitentiaires interpellés dans une affaire de falsification de certificats de nationalité
article_manifest.summary: Bobo-Dioulasso: Two prison officers arrested in a case of forgery of nationality certificates The Public Prosecutor of Burkina Faso at the High Court (TGI) of Bobo-Dioulasso has announced the arrest of two assistants from the Prison Security Guard (GSP), suspected of being involved in a case of forgery of numbers on Burkinabé nationality certificates. . The information was made public in a press release dated 12 November 2026.

article_manifest.title: Bobo-Dioulasso: Certified electronic invoicing at the heart of the 2026 second session of the CNLF
article_manifest.original_title: Bobo-Dioulasso : La facture électronique certifiée au cœur de la deuxième session 2026 de la CNLF
article_manifest.summary: On Thursday, 12 November 2020, the National Anti-Fraud Commission (CNLF) held its second session of the year in Bobo-Dioulasso, dedicated to raising awareness among economic stakeholders about certified electronic invoicing (CEI). The opening ceremony, chaired by the Governor of the Guiriko Region, represented by the Regional Secretary General, Souleymane Nakanabo, brought together administrative authorities, state technical departments and representatives of the private sector to discuss the issues surrounding this reform.

article_manifest.title: Ouagadougou: Three Kalashnikovs and two pistols seized after the dismantling of a network of robbers
article_manifest.original_title: Ouagadougou : Trois Kalachnikovs et deux pistolets saisis après le démantèlement d’un réseau de braqueurs
article_manifest.summary: Ouagadougou: Three AK-47s and two pistols seized after the dismantling of a network of robbers. The National Police have announced that they have dismantled a network of criminals specialising in assaults and armed robberies in Ouagadougou and several surrounding areas. .

article_manifest.title: Ouagadougou: An alleged spiritual guide at the centre of a case of fraud and suspected trafficking of human remains
article_manifest.original_title: Ouagadougou : Un prétendu guide spirituel au cœur d’une affaire d’escroquerie et de trafic présumé de restes humains
article_manifest.summary: The Public Prosecutor's Office at the High Court (TGI) of Ouaga I revealed, on Thursday, 12 November 2026, a case of alleged fraud under the guise of occult practices, which also involves the circulation of a human skull. According to the explanations provided by the Deputy Public Prosecutor of Burkina Faso, Seydou Ouédraogo, an alleged spiritual guide is said to have extorted 3,165,000 CFA francs from a courtyard owner in Ouagadougou, promising to multiply his money through mystical practices.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso/War wounded: General Moussa Diallo visits seven garrisons
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso/ Blessés de guerre : Le général Moussa Diallo en visite dans sept garnisons
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Moussa Diallo, has carried out operational visits to several garrisons in Burkina Faso, to meet soldiers wounded in operations and healthcare personnel in military healthcare facilities. The announcement made by the Central Directorate of the Armed Forces Health Service states that these visits concerned the garrisons of Ouahigouya, Tenkodogo, Fada N'Gourma, Dori, Dédougou, Bobo-Dioulasso and Kaya.

article_manifest.summary: The US has not given up on its military presence in West Africa. After closing its bases in Niger and Chad, Washington is seeking to rebuild a security setup around the Lake Chad basin, where Islamic State (IS) wants to keep expanding.
